purpose: Unblock PC-CROP registration issue #3785 by extending the owner-only issue-4159 readiness diagnostic to identify the actual systemd or Docker Compose Caddy edge without any production mutation.
requiredInvariants: The workflow remains owner-only, issue-4159-only and exact-command gated.
The diagnostic performs no DNS mutation, Caddy write/reload, Compose up/down/restart, container mutation, environment write, secret write, database mutation or application deployment.
Production SSH continues to require the already attested pinned host fingerprint and protected repository secrets.
Exact A and AAAA RR-type evidence is collected with dig; resolver address-family synthesis is not accepted as DNS evidence.
Systemd and Docker Compose Caddy are classified independently; concurrent active edges, multiple Caddy containers or unknown topology fail closed.
Compose labels, the running Caddy container, immutable web image metadata and public port-443 ownership are inspected read-only.
No container ID, Compose project name, host filesystem path, Caddyfile body, full environment, secret value or private key is emitted to logs, artifacts or issue comments.
Caddy config accessibility is reduced to YES, NO or UNKNOWN and configuration content is never published.
The existing web revision and PC_CONTROL_HOST_ENABLED state remain bounded evidence only; the workflow does not change either.
Merge, workflow success and readiness evidence are not production cutover or 9-of-9 journey evidence.
acceptance: The diagnostic reports Caddy source as SYSTEMD, DOCKER_COMPOSE, AMBIGUOUS or NONE.
For Docker Compose Caddy it reports bounded known/running counts, Compose metadata presence and whether that exact container owns public port 443.
The classifier returns READY_FOR_CONTROL_HOST_CUTOVER only when DNS, pinned SSH, one valid active edge, writable edge config and one exact web revision are all independently proven.
A successful run performs no production mutation and introduces no recurring cost.
PC-CROP remains NO-GO until reviewer MFA, First Customer and all 9 of 9 role journeys pass.
